text:
maya: CI red on gpu-nightly (h100). test_kv_cache_stress OOM during warmup. job=4582. anyone available to triage?
ci-bot: Job 4582 failed: exit code 137. CUDA/driver mismatch detected (expected 525.xx, found 515.xx). See /var/log/nvidia-driver.log for details.
ryan: FWIW I saw a few infra image updates last night. maya can you paste the top of the runtime log? @sasha maybe infra rolled something.
maya: here are the last lines from the container log:
```
[2026-03-15T03:22:41Z] nvmlInit failed: Xid 31
[2026-03-15T03:22:41Z] libcuda.so.1: undefined symbol: cuInit_v2
[2026-03-15T03:22:41Z] process 12345 killed by OOM killer
```
ryan: that undefined symbol usually means libcuda and driver mismatch. could be the kernel-driver pair or the base image.
sasha: yup. looks like the node image fell back to the older driver. suggestion: rerun with pinned image `rgw/redwood-h100:driver-525` and set BATCH=1 to avoid warmup allocations. also try limiting CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for repro.
maya: can someone queue a rerun with that image and env? also want a bisect between commits abc123..def456 (last green -> current) if rerun still red.
infra-bot: Rerun queued: 4582-rerun-1 with image=rgw/redwood-h100:driver-525, env=[BATCH=1]. Estimated start ~12m. link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4582-rerun-1
ryan: I'll kick off a bisect in the background. if rerun passes with pinned driver, we can blame infra image. if it fails, i'll narrow to runtime/allocator commits.
sasha: when bisecting, prioritize commits touching `ci/images/Dockerfile.h100`, `runtime/allocator`, and `buildkite/ci-config` — those are frequent culprits. ping me if you need commit CLA access.
maya: thanks folks :thumbsup: attaching the failing PR for context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123 — note this touches kv cache handling but shouldn't affect driver symbols.
ci-bot: Rerun started: 4582-rerun-1 -> assigned node h100-2. live logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4582-rerun-1/logs
maya: i'll watch the rerun and update the PR with an interim note to pin drivers in nightly matrix until we confirm. thanks everyone for the quick responses.
